tldr: the Moon through the 12th house sensitizes rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, and endings.
body:
When the Moon moves through your 12th house, it makes you more sensitive to rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, exhaustion, endings, and what you are not ready to explain. You may notice what is happening out of sight: fatigue, unfinished feelings, private pressure, or the need to step back before you can understand what comes next.

A need, mood, habit, or private reaction may become harder to ignore. It can help you read what you need before the feeling gets louder.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for giving yourself space to process what cannot be solved by pushing harder.

The caution: Watch for treating a temporary mood as the whole truth. The risk is disappearing into avoidance when what you really need is rest, honesty, and quiet support.

The Moon moves through this house for a few days. Treat the feeling as information. Give it a grounded place to land before you react from it.
